approvalTitle: SaaS多租户架构实现任务清单
content:
# Tasks Document: SaaS Multi-Tenant Architecture

## Phase 1: 数据库 Schema 和基础设施 (P0)

- [ ] 1.1 创建 Prisma Schema - MtServer 模型
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/prisma/schema.prisma`
  - 新增 `MtServer` 模型，包含 `platformType`, `middlewareUrl`, `serverAddress` 等字段
  - 新增 `TenantDomain` 模型用于白标域名映射
  - Purpose: 建立多租户数据库基础结构
  - _Leverage: 现有 Tenant 模型_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-1, REQ-MT-2_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer with Prisma ORM expertise | Task: Create MtServer and TenantDomain models in Prisma schema with proper relations to Tenant model, including platformType enum (MT5/MT4), middlewareUrl, serverAddress fields | Restrictions: Must maintain existing Tenant model compatibility, use proper field mappings for snake_case database columns | Success: Models compile without errors, migrations generate correctly, proper foreign key relationships established_

- [ ] 1.2 执行数据库迁移
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/prisma/migrations/`
  - 运行 `npx prisma migrate dev` 创建迁移文件
  - 验证数据库表结构正确
  - Purpose: 应用数据库 Schema 变更
  - _Leverage: 现有迁移工具链_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-1_
  - _Prompt: Role: Database Administrator | Task: Execute Prisma migration to create mt_servers and tenant_domains tables with proper indexes | Restrictions: Must not break existing tables, ensure migration is reversible | Success: Tables created with correct structure, indexes applied, existing data preserved_

- [ ] 1.3 创建种子数据脚本
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/prisma/seed.ts`
  - 添加测试租户和 MT5/MT4 服务器配置
  - 包含示例白标域名映射
  - Purpose: 提供开发和测试数据
  - _Leverage: 现有 seed 脚本结构_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-2_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Create seed data for multi-tenant testing including sample tenants with MT5 and MT4 server configurations | Restrictions: Must not overwrite production data, use conditional seeding | Success: Seed script runs successfully, test data available for development_

## Phase 2: TypeScript 适配层 (P0)

- [ ] 2.1 创建 TradingPlatformAdapter 抽象类
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/adapters/trading-platform.adapter.ts`
  - 定义 `PlatformType` 枚举 (MT5, MT4)
  - 定义统一接口：`TradingUser`, `TradingPosition`, `TradingGroup`
  - 创建抽象类 `TradingPlatformAdapter` 定义所有方法签名
  - Purpose: 建立平台无关的统一 API 接口
  - _Leverage: 无（新建）_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-3, REQ-UM-1_
  - _Prompt: Role: TypeScript Architect | Task: Design abstract TradingPlatformAdapter class with unified interfaces for user management, positions, groups, and health check methods | Restrictions: Must be platform-agnostic, use proper TypeScript generics and abstractions | Success: Abstract class compiles, interfaces are well-defined, supports all required trading operations_

- [ ] 2.2 实现 MT5Adapter
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/adapters/mt5.adapter.ts`
  - 继承 `TradingPlatformAdapter`
  - 实现 MT5 中间件端点映射 (`/api/v1/account/users` 等)
  - 实现字段转换 (`margin_free` -> `marginFree` 等)
  - Purpose: 封装 MT5 中间件 API 调用
  - _Leverage: TradingPlatformAdapter, HttpService_
  - _Requirements: REQ-UM-1 ~ REQ-UM-8_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Implement MT5Adapter extending TradingPlatformAdapter, mapping MT5 middleware endpoints and converting response fields to unified format | Restrictions: Must handle all MT5 API errors gracefully, implement proper timeout handling | Success: All MT5 endpoints mapped correctly, field conversions accurate, error handling robust_

- [ ] 2.3 实现 MT4Adapter
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/adapters/mt4.adapter.ts`
  - 继承 `TradingPlatformAdapter`
  - 实现 MT4 中间件端点映射 (`/api/v1/accounts` 等)
  - 实现字段转换 (`account_id` -> `login`, `free_margin` -> `marginFree` 等)
  - Purpose: 封装 MT4 中间件 API 调用
  - _Leverage: TradingPlatformAdapter, HttpService_
  - _Requirements: REQ-UM-1 ~ REQ-UM-8_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Implement MT4Adapter extending TradingPlatformAdapter, mapping MT4 middleware endpoints with different paths and field names to unified format | Restrictions: Must handle MT4-specific quirks, implement proper error mapping | Success: All MT4 endpoints mapped correctly, field conversions handle MT4 naming conventions, compatible with unified interface_

- [ ] 2.4 创建 TradingAdapterFactory
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/adapters/adapter.factory.ts`
  - 实现工厂方法根据 `platformType` 创建对应适配器
  - 注册为 NestJS Injectable 服务
  - Purpose: 动态创建平台适配器
  - _Leverage: MT5Adapter, MT4Adapter_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-3_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Create TradingAdapterFactory as NestJS injectable service to instantiate correct adapter based on platformType | Restrictions: Must be singleton, support runtime adapter creation | Success: Factory correctly creates MT5 or MT4 adapter based on platform type_

- [ ] 2.5 实现 TradingService
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/trading.service.ts`
  - 注入 PrismaService 和 TradingAdapterFactory
  - 实现适配器缓存 (`Map<string, TradingPlatformAdapter>`)
  - 实现 `getAdapter(tenantId, serverId)` 方法
  - 实现所有用户管理方法代理
  - Purpose: 提供统一的交易平台服务层
  - _Leverage: PrismaService, TradingAdapterFactory_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-3, REQ-UM-1 ~ REQ-UM-8_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Implement TradingService with adapter caching, database lookup for server config, and delegation to appropriate adapter | Restrictions: Must cache adapters efficiently, handle cache invalidation, proper error handling | Success: Service correctly routes requests to appropriate adapter, caching works, all user management methods available_

- [ ] 2.6 创建 TradingModule
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/trading.module.ts`
  - 注册所有适配器和服务
  - 导出 TradingService 供其他模块使用
  - Purpose: 模块化交易平台功能
  - _Leverage: NestJS Module 系统_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-3_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Create NestJS TradingModule registering adapters, factory, and service with proper exports | Restrictions: Follow NestJS module patterns, maintain proper dependency injection | Success: Module compiles, services injectable, properly exported_

## Phase 3: MT5 中间件多租户改造 (P0)

- [ ] 3.1 重命名 ManagerSessionPool 为 MT5ManagerSessionPool
  - File: `MT5-middleware/include/services/MT5ManagerSessionPool.h`
  - File: `MT5-middleware/src/services/MT5ManagerSessionPool.cpp`
  - 重命名类和文件
  - 更新所有引用
  - Purpose: 明确组件职责范围
  - _Leverage: 现有 ManagerSessionPool 代码_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-1_
  - _Prompt: Role: C++ Developer | Task: Rename ManagerSessionPool to MT5ManagerSessionPool across all files and update all references | Restrictions: Must update all include statements, maintain backward compatibility during transition | Success: All references updated, code compiles without errors_

- [ ] 3.2 实现 PoolKey 结构和多租户支持
  - File: `MT5-middleware/include/services/MT5ManagerSessionPool.h`
  - 添加 `PoolKey` 结构体 (tenantId, serverId)
  - 添加 `PoolKeyHash` 用于 unordered_map
  - 修改连接池使用 `PoolKey` 作为 Key
  - Purpose: 支持多租户连接隔离
  - _Leverage: 现有连接池逻辑_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-1, REQ-MT-4_
  - _Prompt: Role: C++ Developer | Task: Implement PoolKey struct with tenantId and serverId, create hash function, modify connection pool to use PoolKey as key | Restrictions: Must be thread-safe, efficient hash implementation | Success: Multi-tenant connection isolation works, no cross-tenant data leakage_

- [ ] 3.3 实现按租户粒度的熔断器
  - File: `MT5-middleware/include/services/MT5ManagerSessionPool.h`
  - 为每个 `tenant_id:server_id` 创建独立 CircuitBreaker
  - 实现 `executeWithCircuitBreaker` 模板方法
  - Purpose: 租户级别故障隔离
  - _Leverage: 现有 CircuitBreaker 实现_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-4, REQ-MT-5_
  - _Prompt: Role: C++ Developer | Task: Create per-tenant circuit breaker instances, implement executeWithCircuitBreaker template method with proper state management | Restrictions: Must not affect other tenants when one fails, proper state transitions | Success: Circuit breaker isolates failures per tenant:server, automatic recovery works_

- [ ] 3.4 扩展 JWT 解析支持 tenant_id
  - File: `MT5-middleware/include/filters/JWTFilter.h`
  - File: `MT5-middleware/src/filters/JWTFilter.cpp`
  - 从 JWT payload 提取 `tenant_id` 和 `server_id`
  - 存储到请求属性中供 Controller 使用
  - Purpose: 支持多租户请求路由
  - _Leverage: 现有 JWT 解析逻辑_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-1_
  - _Prompt: Role: C++ Developer | Task: Extend JWTFilter to extract tenant_id and server_id from JWT payload, store in request attributes | Restrictions: Must handle missing fields gracefully, maintain backward compatibility | Success: Tenant info available in all authenticated requests_

- [ ] 3.5 实现 UsersController
  - File: `MT5-middleware/include/controllers/UsersController.h`
  - File: `MT5-middleware/src/controllers/UsersController.cpp`
  - 实现用户列表、详情、分组、持仓、历史 API
  - 实现用户组、杠杆、状态修改 API
  - 从请求中提取租户信息调用 MT5ManagerSessionPool
  - Purpose: 提供用户管理 REST API
  - _Leverage: MT5ManagerSessionPool, MT5Manager_
  - _Requirements: REQ-UM-1 ~ REQ-UM-8_
  - _Prompt: Role: C++ Developer with Drogon framework experience | Task: Implement UsersController with all CRUD endpoints for user management, extracting tenant info and delegating to session pool | Restrictions: Must use circuit breaker protection, proper error responses, pagination support | Success: All user management endpoints work correctly, proper error handling, multi-tenant isolation_

- [ ] 3.6 实现 HealthController
  - File: `MT5-middleware/include/controllers/HealthController.h`
  - File: `MT5-middleware/src/controllers/HealthController.cpp`
  - 实现健康检查端点 `/api/v1/health`
  - 实现服务器状态查询 `/api/v1/health/servers`
  - 实现熔断器重置 API
  - Purpose: 提供健康监控和熔断器管理
  - _Leverage: MT5ManagerSessionPool_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-5_
  - _Prompt: Role: C++ Developer | Task: Implement HealthController with health check, server status, and circuit breaker reset endpoints | Restrictions: Admin-only for reset, expose appropriate metrics | Success: Health monitoring works, circuit breaker can be manually reset_

## Phase 4: tenant-api 统一 API (P1)

- [ ] 4.1 创建 TradingController
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/trading.controller.ts`
  - 实现统一的用户管理 API 端点
  - 从 JWT 提取 tenant_id, server_id
  - 委托给 TradingService 处理
  - Purpose: 对前端暴露统一 API
  - _Leverage: TradingService, JwtAuthGuard_
  - _Requirements: REQ-UM-1 ~ REQ-UM-8_
  - _Prompt: Role: NestJS Developer | Task: Create TradingController with unified endpoints for user management, extracting tenant context from JWT and delegating to TradingService | Restrictions: Must validate all inputs, proper error responses, use existing auth guards | Success: Unified API works for both MT4 and MT5, proper authentication and authorization_

- [ ] 4.2 扩展 JWT 签发逻辑
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/auth/auth.service.ts`
  - 在 JWT payload 中添加 `tenant_id`, `server_id`, `platform_type`
  - 登录时根据用户关联的租户和服务器生成
  - Purpose: 支持多租户认证
  - _Leverage: 现有 JWT 签发逻辑_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-1, REQ-FE-2_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Extend JWT payload to include tenant_id, server_id, and platform_type based on user's tenant association | Restrictions: Must maintain backward compatibility, proper token expiration | Success: JWT contains all required tenant information, existing auth flows still work_

- [ ] 4.3 实现租户域名解析服务
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/tenant/tenant.service.ts`
  - 实现 `getTenantByDomain(domain)` 方法
  - 支持子域名约定解析 (`tenant-code.platform.com`)
  - 支持白标域名查询 (`TenantDomain` 表)
  - Purpose: 支持前端租户识别
  - _Leverage: PrismaService, TenantDomain 模型_
  - _Requirements: REQ-FE-1, REQ-FE-2_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Implement tenant resolution by domain supporting both subdomain convention and white-label domain lookup | Restrictions: Must be efficient with caching, handle unknown domains gracefully | Success: Tenant correctly resolved from any supported domain format_

- [ ] 4.4 创建租户查询 API
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/tenant/tenant.controller.ts`
  - 实现 `GET /api/tenant/resolve?domain=xxx` 端点
  - 返回租户配置（不含敏感信息）
  - Purpose: 供前端获取租户配置
  - _Leverage: TenantService_
  - _Requirements: REQ-FE-1_
  - _Prompt: Role: NestJS Developer | Task: Create public endpoint for tenant resolution by domain, returning safe tenant configuration | Restrictions: Must not expose sensitive data like credentials, rate limiting recommended | Success: Frontend can resolve tenant from domain, appropriate data returned_

## Phase 5: 健康监控 (P1)

- [ ] 5.1 tenant-api 健康聚合服务
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/health/health.service.ts`
  - 聚合所有中间件的健康状态
  - 通过适配器获取各平台健康信息
  - Purpose: 统一健康状态视图
  - _Leverage: TradingService, 各适配器的 healthCheck 方法_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-5_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Create health aggregation service that collects health status from all configured middleware instances | Restrictions: Must handle timeout gracefully, cache results appropriately | Success: Aggregated health view available, individual server status accessible_

- [ ] 5.2 tenant-api 健康 API
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/health/health.controller.ts`
  - 实现 `GET /api/health` 总体健康检查
  - 实现 `GET /api/health/servers` 详细服务器状态
  - 实现 `POST /api/health/servers/:tenantId/:serverId/reset` 熔断器重置
  - Purpose: 提供健康监控 API
  - _Leverage: HealthService_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-5_
  - _Prompt: Role: NestJS Developer | Task: Create health controller with aggregated health check and individual server status endpoints | Restrictions: Reset endpoint must be admin-only, proper status codes | Success: Health monitoring accessible via API, circuit breaker reset works_

## Phase 6: 混合部署支持 (P2)

- [ ] 6.1 API Gateway 路由配置
  - File: `docker/nginx/nginx.conf` 或相关配置
  - 配置基于租户的路由规则
  - 大租户路由到独立中间件实例
  - 小租户路由到共享实例
  - Purpose: 支持混合部署架构
  - _Leverage: 现有 Nginx 配置_
  - _Requirements: REQ-DP-1, REQ-DP-2_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Configure Nginx routing rules to direct requests to appropriate middleware instances based on tenant deployment mode | Restrictions: Must maintain session affinity where needed, proper load balancing | Success: Requests correctly routed based on tenant configuration_

- [ ] 6.2 部署模式配置管理
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/tenant/tenant.service.ts`
  - 添加 `getDeploymentConfig(tenantId)` 方法
  - 返回租户的 `deployment_mode` 和 `middleware_url`
  - Purpose: 支持动态部署配置
  - _Leverage: Tenant 模型_
  - _Requirements: REQ-DP-1_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Implement deployment configuration lookup for tenants to support shared vs dedicated middleware routing | Restrictions: Must cache configuration, support runtime updates | Success: Deployment mode correctly retrieved and used for routing_

## Phase 7: MT4 适配器完善 (P3)

- [ ] 7.1 完善 MT4Adapter 端点映射
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/adapters/mt4.adapter.ts`
  - 根据实际 MT4 中间件 API 完善所有端点映射
  - 处理 MT4 特有的响应格式
  - Purpose: 完整支持 MT4 平台
  - _Leverage: MT4 中间件 API 文档_
  - _Requirements: REQ-UM-1 ~ REQ-UM-8_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Complete MT4Adapter implementation based on actual MT4 middleware API specification | Restrictions: Must handle all MT4-specific edge cases | Success: All MT4 operations work correctly through unified interface_

- [ ] 7.2 MT4 特有功能处理
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/adapters/mt4.adapter.ts`
  - 处理 MT4 独有的功能或限制
  - 在统一接口中优雅降级
  - Purpose: 处理平台差异
  - _Leverage: TradingPlatformAdapter_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-3_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Handle MT4-specific features and gracefully degrade for unsupported operations | Restrictions: Must not break unified interface, proper error messages for unsupported features | Success: MT4-specific features handled, graceful degradation for differences_

- [ ] 7.3 混合平台集成测试
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/test/trading.e2e-spec.ts`
  - 编写 MT4 和 MT5 混合场景测试
  - 验证适配器切换正确
  - 验证数据格式统一
  - Purpose: 确保多平台集成正确
  - _Leverage: Jest, Supertest_
  - _Requirements: All_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer | Task: Create E2E tests covering mixed MT4/MT5 scenarios, verifying correct adapter routing and unified data formats | Restrictions: Must test both platforms in same test suite, mock middleware where needed | Success: All mixed platform scenarios pass, data format consistency verified_

## Phase 8: 测试任务

- [ ] 8.1 TypeScript 适配层单元测试
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/adapters/*.spec.ts`
  - 测试各适配器的端点映射和字段转换
  - Mock HTTP 调用
  - Purpose: 确保适配器逻辑正确
  - _Leverage: Jest, HttpService mock_
  - _Requirements: REQ-UM-1 ~ REQ-UM-8_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer | Task: Create unit tests for MT5Adapter and MT4Adapter covering endpoint mapping and field conversion | Restrictions: Must mock HTTP calls, test all conversion methods | Success: All adapter methods tested, edge cases covered_

- [ ] 8.2 TradingService 单元测试
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/trading/trading.service.spec.ts`
  - 测试适配器缓存和路由逻辑
  - Mock PrismaService 和适配器
  - Purpose: 确保服务层逻辑正确
  - _Leverage: Jest, Prisma mock_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-3_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer | Task: Create unit tests for TradingService covering adapter caching and routing logic | Restrictions: Must mock dependencies, test cache behavior | Success: Service routing and caching logic verified_

- [ ] 8.3 MT5 中间件多租户测试
  - File: `MT5-middleware/tests/`
  - 测试多租户连接隔离
  - 测试熔断器按租户粒度工作
  - Purpose: 确保 C++ 层多租户实现正确
  - _Leverage: Google Test_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-4, REQ-MT-5_
  - _Prompt: Role: C++ QA Engineer | Task: Create tests for MT5ManagerSessionPool multi-tenant isolation and per-tenant circuit breaker | Restrictions: Must test concurrent access, failure isolation | Success: Multi-tenant isolation verified, circuit breaker works per tenant_

- [ ] 8.4 端到端集成测试
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/test/multi-tenant.e2e-spec.ts`
  - 测试完整的多租户流程
  - 测试租户 A 故障不影响租户 B
  - Purpose: 验证整体架构正确
  - _Leverage: Jest, Supertest, Docker_
  - _Requirements: REQ-MT-4, REQ-MT-5_
  - _Prompt: Role: QA Engineer | Task: Create E2E tests for complete multi-tenant workflow including fault isolation between tenants | Restrictions: Must simulate real scenarios, test failure propagation | Success: Multi-tenant workflow works end-to-end, fault isolation verified_
